# Buffered list rows keep their old records after a scroll under load

## Context

Found while hardening neomjs/neo-agent-institution#703's e2e journey (`FleetActivityObserver.spec.mjs:120`). It failed once in CI (run 38762781142, attempt 1) and passed on re-run. Locally it reproduces 6/6 under 6× CPU throttling (CDP `Emulation.setCPUThrottlingRate`) on Engine `2d3e6fa8`. `src/list/Buffered.mjs`, `src/mixin/VdomLifecycle.mjs` and `src/manager/VDomUpdate.mjs` are identical on dev `906244aa`.

**Observed** after one wheel to the end of a 30-row `Neo.list.Buffered` whose items are `itemConfig` components (App worker read through `Neo.worker.App.getConfigs`):
- list: `scrollTop` 836, `mountedRange` `[18, 30]`, `isVdomUpdating` false, `needsVdomUpdate` false
- every pooled row component: its `vdom` holds the new record (`all message 75`), its `vnode` and the DOM the old one (`all message 3`)
- nothing is queued, so the rows stay stale until some later list update ships them.

**Observed sequence** (App-worker wrappers on `onScrollCapture`, `createItems`, `updateVdom`, `getVdomUpdatePayload`, `resolveVdomUpdate`):
1. `onScrollCapture(836)` arrives as one event while the list is idle (`needsVdomUpdate: false`).
2. `createItems` → `getPooledComponent` re-binds all 12 rows with `component.set(update, true)`. Each row's `updateVdom` runs silent and finds no ancestor with a pending update to merge into, so it only flags itself.
3. The list raises `updateDepth` to 3 and starts its own update. Its payload is built with `ids` = an **empty Set**, so sparse tree generation treats every row as clean: `payload LIST depth=3 ids=` → `resolve LIST`, with no row payload and no row resolve.

In the passing store swap just before it, the rows were re-bound while the list already had a pending update. They merged, and the payload carried them (`payload LIST depth=3 ids=row0|…|row11`).

## The Problem

`list.Buffered` changes its pooled descendants silently and relies on its own update, with a raised `updateDepth`, to ship them. That holds only when the rows happen to merge into that update. When the list is idle as the re-bind happens, any non-null merged set makes the payload sparse, and the silently changed rows fall outside it. Under load, the operator sees the previous records in the new positions until another list update lands.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/list/Buffered.mjs` `getPooledComponent()` (L557–615) re-binds with `component.set(update, true)` and raises `me.updateDepth = Math.max(me.updateDepth, 1 + TreeBuilder.getComponentDepth(component))` (L612). It never declares the change dense.
- `src/mixin/VdomLifecycle.mjs` L330: `const ids = component.updateDepth !== 1 && !component.denseUpdate ? mergedChildIds : null;`. A payload is sparse unless its owner says otherwise.
- `src/manager/VDomUpdate.mjs` `getMergedChildIds()` (L464) returns `new Set(item.children.keys())` for any existing entry. An entry whose children were detached therefore yields an empty set, not `null` (inferred from the observed empty `ids`).
- Precedent, same class: `src/grid/View.mjs` L879 and L1249 set `denseUpdate = true` beside their raised depth ("The rows changed silently, so a body update merging into this cycle must not make it sparse", #18719 / `d6d0d14bd4`). `src/component/Base.mjs` L1662 (`hide()`) and `src/form/Fieldset.mjs` L222/L227 do the same.
- Design authority: `src/mixin/VdomLifecycle.mjs` L44–46, the `denseUpdate` JSDoc: "True for one update cycle: the owner changed descendants silently within its `updateDepth`, so the cycle ships that subtree whole instead of sparse, even when children merge into it." The list's own comment (L609–611) holds the same contract: without the reach, "mounted child components stop at `neoIgnore` and keep the record that first occupied their physical slot".

## The Fix

`src/list/Buffered.mjs#getPooledComponent`: set `me.denseUpdate = true` where the depth is raised, with its one-line reason. This mirrors `grid/View.mjs`.

Witness: with that line patched into the Engine copy, the throttled journey passes 4/4, and every row's vdom, vnode and DOM agree. Without it the journey failed 6/6.

Unit spec beside `test/playwright/unit/list/Buffered.spec.mjs`: a buffered list with `itemConfig` components, an idle list, then a scroll-capture jump that re-binds the pool. Assert that the payload is dense and every pooled row's vnode carries its new record after the update settles. It must be red on dev and green with the fix.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `getPooledComponent` declares a silent re-bind dense, with its reason.
- [ ] A unit spec reproduces the stranded rows on the current code (red, shown in the PR) and passes with the fix.
- [ ] `npm run test-unit` full suite on the merge-base and the head: no new failures.
- [ ] Post-merge: the #703 journey passes under 6× CPU throttling against Engine dev, and #703's `Isolated Institution` CI job is green.

## Out of Scope

- Whether `VDomUpdate#getMergedChildIds` should return `null` for an entry without children. With the dense declaration the list no longer depends on it, and changing the manager's contract touches every sparse owner.
- The earlier `list.Buffered` sighting (defect-note `MESSAGE:b46a3373`): a store that empties and refills before its update lands leaves the emptied population's pooled rows in the DOM. That trigger (pool trim and recreate) is different. Re-test it against this fix, and keep it as its own note if it survives.
- neomjs/neo-agent-institution#703 itself: its spec is the witness and stays as is.

## Avoided Traps

- Hardening the e2e with a second wheel or a wait. The first wheel already moved the DOM. A second scroll only triggers an update that heals the drift, which hides a race the operator can see.
- `updateDepth = -1`. `hasUpdateCollision` treats it as colliding at every distance (see `grid/View.mjs` L1244–1246).
- Returning `null` from `getMergedChildIds` for an empty entry. That fixes this path only by accident: a list with one genuinely merged child (focus, selection) would still prune the re-bound rows.
